title: How Are You?
label: ch:ar-how-are-you
canDo: I can ask an Arabic speaker how they are, answer that I am well, and change the ending of the question to match a man or a woman.

payoff.summary: The whole how-are-you exchange, run once to a man and once to a woman, with bi-khayr written out by hand and the chapter's letters, roots and literal meanings recalled from memory.
payoff.note: AR-C03-practice assesses all nineteen atoms the chapter introduces: the exchange and its pieces, the hook-and-tail family, ك and the non-joining ر, spelling خير and writing بخير, which letters of the chapter's phrases are new, and a spoken recall of the -ka/-ki question, both literal answers, ḥāl as how things have turned, kayfiyya, ḥājj and the ḥ-m-d root.
